integrity.algebraic_checks: ten resultants, two greatest common divisors, simple roots, normalized shells and integrability fractions
integrity.fourier_convention: exp(-i x dot xi); associated Laguerre polynomial argument |xi|^2/2
integrity.mathematical_audit: self-review only; independent audit not performed

scientific_limitations: Complete only for pairs of excitation levels 0 through 4, dimension d a positive integer.
Operators are the explicitly normalized isotropic Gaussian-Laguerre convolution filters, not higher-dimensional Toeplitz compressions.
Common Laguerre zero identities may have antecedents in classical special-function literature.
Infinite-dimensional Bessel/PDE arguments require independent mathematical verification.
title: First simultaneous blind shells of isotropic Gaussian–Laguerre filters and the sharp integrability threshold
